units.source_text: “由于我生病，这盘棋中途暂停了。

en.t: Because I fell ill, this game was suspended midway.

units.source_text: 但我不希望第三者拿未下完的一盘棋随便评头论足，

en.t: But I do not want outsiders to make casual judgments about an unfinished game,

units.source_text: 对黑白孰优孰劣说三道四。”

en.t: or to gossip about whether Black or White has the advantage.

units.source_text: 这番话颇符合当时名人的语气。

en.t: These words were quite in keeping with the Master's tone at the time.

units.source_text: 不是对弈者，毕竟不知道作战的发展趋向。

en.t: After all, someone who was not one of the players could not know how the battle would develop.
That was probably the truth of the matter as well.
